segments.title: British battlecruiser costs from Invincible to Hood
segments.body: A precise cost comparison from HMS Invincible to HMS Hood is left unresolved. The prices of the intervening British battlecruisers are described as incompletely known, which limits any estimate of how quickly expenditure rose. A roughly rising curve is suggested, but no ship-by-ship figures are supplied. The proposed chart would therefore be an approximation, with the intermediate costs still uncertain.

evidence.note: Dr. Clarke says the intervening ship costs are not all known, although they can be represented approximately as a rising curve.

segments.summary: A rough rising cost curve is suggested for British battlecruisers between HMS Invincible and HMS Hood, with the intermediate prices left uncertain.
segments.question: Can the cost growth of British battlecruisers between HMS Invincible and HMS Hood be tracked?
segments.answerShort: Only approximately in this answer: a rising curve is suggested, while missing intermediate prices leave the rate of increase uncertain.
